title: Theory of Airy-Beam Wavefront Sensing
summary: A new wavefront sensing framework based on the interference of counter-accelerating Airy beams is presented. An engineered cubic phase function transforms a single Gaussian beam into two coherent Airy beams with opposite transverse accelerations, which self-recombine during free-space propagation to form an interference pattern encoding the aberrated incident wavefront.
